edge_explainer: Screen showed EV/EBIT 7.9x, 40% of cap in net cash, P/B 1.69, FCF yield 2.1% on 31-Dec-2025 data. Primary verification: net cash CONFIRMED exactly (£21.580m cash, zero borrowings; £23.1m at 30-Jun-2026), capital commitments £nil (Note 30), no defined-benefit pension (DC only), deferred income only £1.553m so the cash is shareholder cash not customer money, and capitalised development (£4.381m, 6.9% of revenue) is now EXCEEDED by amortisation (~£6.0m) so EBIT is not flattered — though 'adjusted EBITDA' £11.33m against CFO £5.55m and FCF £1.10m is flattered by ~£7.3m. Three corrections to the screen: (1) PFIC flag is a SCREEN ERROR — it fired on book assets (55%) but §1297(e) requires fair-market-value for a listed issuer and the row's own pfic_fmv_share is 0.354, with passive income ~1% of gross; not a PFIC at 148p but likely one below ~107p, so the de-rate manufactures the status; (2) the 'melting' flag (EBIT 0.44x peak) is true history but stale — the FY24 peak was inflated by one-off Soluna platform-BUILD revenue and H1-2026 adjusted EBITDA tripled to £5.0-5.4m; (3) the audited row is 7 months stale and superseded by the 29-Jul-2026 update. The blocking finding is not a screen defect at all: the 2025 Annual Report discloses the California contract runs to mid-2027 with no successor agreed, and Note 2.3 discloses either party may terminate without penalty on a fixed notice period. HONESTY: ELEVATE on takeaway-divergence — the 71% concentration is disclosed in Note 4 and the auditor's Key Audit Matter, but the Principal Risks and Uncertainties section lists seven risks and omits customer concentration and contract renewal entirely, while the strategy narrative claims the 'State Alliance Model reduces customer concentration risk' on the strength of non-California US contracts worth ~4-5% of the California line. Cause-check: the de-rate is the 23-Sep-2025 H1 results (adjusted EBITDA £1.6m vs £7.8m, £2.1m operating loss); the 23-Mar-2026 100p low has no dated RNS cause; the 26-May-2026 175.5p high most plausibly followed the 19-May annual report first disclosing the mid-2027 contract horizon (PLAUSIBLE, unconfirmed).
